lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, main FedEx courier se bol raha hoon. Aapke naam se ek parcel Taiwan bheja gaya hai.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Us parcel mein 150 gram MDMA aur teen passport mile hain. Yeh bahut serious matter hai.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Main aapki call Mumbai police ko transfer kar raha hoon.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Mumbai crime branch, main Inspector Shinde. Aapke khilaaf FIR darj ho gayi hai. Aap digital arrest mein hain.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Ghar mein kisi ko kuch nahi batana hai. Video call band mat karna.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Apne bank ka saara balance RBI ke verification account mein daal dijiye, jaanch ke baad wapas mil jayega.
